ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's arrival tap to Ryde account review for a fake arrival confirmation; + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip and kept the $6.61 cancellation fee on a no-show claim, which brings the case in through NS-0 ([F3]) — cancelled_by = driver, so the fee stands only if NS-1 is satisfied ([RD-1] is not in issue here; the charge is a cancellation fee, not an off-route fare). NS-1 requires three elements together, and the trace settles all three.

(i) is met: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5]. (ii) fails: at the moment of that tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point, and his closest approach across the whole trip was 599 m at 12:06:55 — he never came within 200 m [F1][F5]. (iii) also fails: he stayed inside the pickup radius for 0 s after the tap, never the >3 minutes NS-1 demands [F5]. The timeline independently confirms it: driver_arrived_at is null, i.e. the platform never recorded the driver at the pickup point [F4].

Because (ii) and (iii) both fail, NS-1 cannot support the fee, and NS-2 applies: the $6.61 is refunded in full. The amount is the recorded cancellation fee itself — $6.61 [F6][F3] — so the computation is simply 6.61 × 1 = $6.61 (refund_full of the disputed item under NS-2; the fare record also shows a 1.0× surge, so nothing else is bundled in) [F7].

NS-2's second limb is also engaged: the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him 600 m away, well outside the 200 m pickup radius, which is the abuse-of-the-arrival-button pattern NS-2 flags for account review [F5][F1]. The driver's written statement asserting he waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup [F12] is contradicted by the system record [F1][F2][F5], and system records override statements, so it does not save the fee; the rider's chat at 12:07 confirming no car was at the pickup point is consistent with the GPS [F9].

The chat contains no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation: the driver's messages are a pickup prompt and a cancellation notice [F8][F10], and the rider's message is a location query [F9]; the complaint reports a false arrival, not abuse or safety risk.

actions.detail: account action is never automatic; queued for Ryde review

what_would_change: Had NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both held ((ii) within 200 m of pickup AT THE MOMENT of the arrival confirmation; (iii) stayed at the pickup more than 3 min after the arrival confirmation, until cancelling (NS-1 default: more than 3 min)), the fee would stand and no refund would be due.
